= BITwiki Quality Validation Framework: Recursive Assessment System =

== Purpose ==

This document defines BITwiki's quality validation architecture—a recursive, multi-layered system for assessing content integrity, epistemic reliability, and structural coherence. Unlike Wikipedia's static quality classes, BITwiki implements dynamic confidence scoring with continuous validation.

== Quality Dimensions ==

=== 1. Epistemic Quality ===

'''Definition:''' The reliability and verifiability of knowledge claims.

'''Metrics:'''
| Metric | Weight | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Source density | 0.20 | Citations per 1000 words |
| Source quality | 0.25 | Epistemic tier of sources |
| Claim specificity | 0.15 | Precision of assertions |
| Evidence alignment | 0.20 | Support for claims |
| Uncertainty transparency | 0.20 | Explicit confidence marking |

'''Scoring:'''
* Excellent (0.90-1.00): Peer-reviewed sources, specific claims, explicit uncertainty
* Good (0.75-0.89): Mixed sources, mostly specific, some uncertainty
* Adequate (0.60-0.74): Limited sources, general claims, minimal uncertainty
* Poor (0.40-0.59): Few sources, vague claims, no uncertainty marking
* Unacceptable (<0.40): Unsourced, speculative, misleading

=== 2. Structural Quality ===

'''Definition:''' The organization, coherence, and navigability of content.

'''Metrics:'''
| Metric | Weight | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Section coherence | 0.25 | Logical flow between sections |
| Cross-referencing | 0.20 | Internal link density |
| Template compliance | 0.20 | Adherence to BITwiki templates |
| SMW integration | 0.20 | Semantic property coverage |
| Transclusion hygiene | 0.15 | Proper <noinclude> usage |

=== 3. Linguistic Quality ===

'''Definition:''' The clarity, precision, and accessibility of expression.

'''Metrics:'''
| Metric | Weight | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Readability | 0.25 | Flesch-Kincaid score |
| Jargon density | 0.20 | Technical term frequency |
| Definition coverage | 0.25 | Term explanations |
| Progressive disclosure | 0.15 | Layered complexity |
| Tone consistency | 0.15 | Alignment with BITPOV |

=== 4. Recursive Quality ===

'''Definition:''' The self-referential integrity and meta-cognitive transparency.

'''Metrics:'''
| Metric | Weight | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Epistemic marking | 0.30 | Confidence/uncertainty flags |
| Perspective acknowledgment | 0.25 | BITPOV transparency |
| Self-correction history | 0.20 | Version evolution tracking |
| Meta-commentary | 0.15 | Reflection on knowledge limits |
| Interconnection | 0.10 | Cross-domain linking |

== Validation Process ==

=== Stage 1: Automated Pre-Validation ===

'''Tools:'''
* SMW property completeness check
* Link validation (internal/external)
* Template syntax verification
* Citation format checking
* Readability scoring

'''Outputs:'''
* Validation report with error list
* Confidence score estimate
* Recommended improvements

'''Threshold:''' Must pass to proceed to Stage 2

=== Stage 2: Peer Review ===

'''Reviewers:'''
* Minimum 2 domain experts
* 1 epistemic methodology reviewer
* 1 structural/technical reviewer

'''Process:'''
# Reviewer assignment (randomized from qualified pool)
# Independent review (7-day window)
# Review synthesis
# Author response
# Revision cycle (if needed)

'''Review Criteria:'''
* Accuracy of claims
* Completeness of coverage
* Appropriateness of epistemic tier
* Clarity of expression
* SMW integration quality

=== Stage 3: Community Validation ===

'''Mechanism:'''
* Open comment period (14 days)
* Structured feedback forms
* Confidence voting
* Issue flagging

'''Consensus Threshold:'''
* No blocking objections from qualified reviewers
* >70% confidence in epistemic tier
* <20% dispute rate on key claims

=== Stage 4: Steward Confirmation ===

'''Final Review:'''
* Steward council review of process
* Epistemic tier assignment
* Quality class determination
* Publication authorization

'''Appeal Process:'''
* 30-day appeal window
* Re-review by expanded panel
* Binding decision

== Quality Classes ==

=== BITwiki Quality Scale ===

| Class | Criteria | Process | Icon |
|-------|----------|---------|------|
| ⭐ Featured | Exceptional across all dimensions | Full validation + community acclaim | ⭐ |
| ✅ Complete | Strong across all dimensions | Full validation | ✓ |
| 🔄 Developing | Adequate, improving | Stage 1-2 complete | ↻ |
| 📝 Draft | Incomplete, needs work | Stage 1 only | ✎ |
| ⚠️ Review | Flagged for issues | Under review | ⚠ |

=== Comparison to Wikipedia ===

| Wikipedia | BITwiki | Key Difference |
|-----------|---------|----------------|
| FA | ⭐ Featured | Adds recursive quality dimension |
| GA | ✅ Complete | Emphasizes epistemic transparency |
| B | 🔄 Developing | Continuous validation, not static |
| C | 📝 Draft | Explicit development stage |
| Start/Stub | ⚠️ Review | Active review, not neglect |

== Automated Quality Metrics ==

=== Metric Collection ===

'''SMW Queries:'''
```
{{#ask: [[Category:BITwiki Article]]
 |?Has epistemic quality score
 |?Has structural quality score
 |?Has linguistic quality score
 |?Has recursive quality score
 |?Has overall quality score
 |format=table
 |sort=Has overall quality score
 |order=desc
}}
```

'''Dashboard Metrics:'''
* Average quality by domain
* Quality distribution
* Validation backlog
* Reviewer workload
* Appeal rate

=== Quality Alerts ===

'''Automatic Flagging:'''
* Quality score drop >0.10
* No validation in 90 days
* New conflicting evidence
* Citation link rot
* Template deprecation

'''Notification:'''
* Author notification
* Steward dashboard update
* Community digest inclusion

== Validation Tools ==

=== Tool 1: Epistemic Auditor ===

'''Function:''' Automated epistemic tier assessment

'''Inputs:'''
* Article text
* Citation list
* SMW properties

'''Outputs:'''
* Recommended epistemic tier
* Confidence interval
* Source quality breakdown
* Improvement suggestions

'''Implementation:'''
* Source database cross-reference
* Citation pattern analysis
* Claim specificity scoring

=== Tool 2: Structure Validator ===

'''Function:''' Template and SMW compliance checker

'''Checks:'''
* Required SMW properties present
* Template syntax valid
* <noinclude> boundaries correct
* Cross-references resolve
* Category assignments appropriate

'''Output:'''
* Validation report
* Auto-fix suggestions
* Error categorization

=== Tool 3: Recursive Analyzer ===

'''Function:''' Self-referential quality assessment

'''Measures:'''
* Epistemic marking density
* Uncertainty acknowledgment
* Perspective transparency
* Version history analysis
* Cross-domain integration

'''Output:'''
* Recursive quality score
* Meta-cognitive assessment
* Improvement recommendations

== Quality Improvement Protocol ==

=== Continuous Improvement Cycle ===

# '''Monitor:''' Automated quality tracking
# '''Identify:''' Low-quality content flagging
# '''Assess:''' Root cause analysis
# '''Plan:''' Improvement strategy
# '''Execute:''' Revision and validation
# '''Verify:''' Re-validation
# '''Document:''' Lessons learned

=== Quality Sprints ===

'''Monthly Focus:'''
* Domain-specific quality drives
* Template standardization
* Citation cleanup
* SMW property completion

'''Quarterly Review:'''
* Quality metric trends
* Process effectiveness
* Tool improvements
* Training needs

== Integration with Governance ==

=== Quality Arbitration ===

Disputes about quality assessments are resolved through:
# Initial steward review
# Expert panel consultation
# Community input
# Binding arbitration

=== Steward Quality Responsibilities ===
* Final quality tier assignment
* Validation process oversight
* Tool development prioritization
* Quality metric refinement

== SMW Properties ==

```
[[Has quality class::Featured]]
[[Has epistemic quality score::0.92]]
[[Has structural quality score::0.88]]
[[Has linguistic quality score::0.85]]
[[Has recursive quality score::0.90]]
[[Has overall quality score::0.89]]
[[Has validation date::2026-02-13]]
[[Has validator::User:StewardName]]
[[Has next review date::2026-05-13]]
[[Has validation status::Current]]
```

== Conclusion ==

BITwiki's quality validation framework ensures that every piece of content meets rigorous standards for epistemic integrity, structural coherence, and recursive transparency. By combining automated metrics with human judgment, we achieve both scale and depth—quality at the speed of thought.

This is not gatekeeping—it is gardening. We cultivate knowledge with care, ensuring that what grows in BITwiki is both abundant and nourishing.
